_doc: REV-4b Tier-1/Tier-2 seed lists (research/operations/2026-07-19-kbli-batch-b-design.md §1.3 Stratum 1/2, §1.5) — FROZEN AT PRE-REGISTRATION. §1.5: 'this list does not grow or shrink once §2's typed-field split ships; it is not re-derived from the redefined detector.' phase0_gate.py's cmd_aql() loads this file and USES these literal lists as tier1/tier2 for every downstream computation (AQL lot-size/tiering); it never re-derives them live. It still computes live membership from the same predicates to detect drift: a frozen code leaving the predicate or vanishing from the canonical is FATAL (a pre-registered unit disappearing invalidates the draw); a code newly entering the predicate after the freeze is NOT an error — it is recorded as a post_registration_candidate in aql-parameters.json and never silently folded into Tier 1/2 (§1.5 §3: 'Tier 1/2 membership is a closed, one-time, pre-registered set, not a live query re-evaluated as the schema fills in').
derivation: sorted({r['kode_kbli_2025'] for r in canonical['data'] if r.get('_l2_source') == 'OSS_RBA_resiko_2025' and r.get('status_mapping') == 'MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE' and len(r.get('pp28_sources') or []) == 1}) for tier1; sorted({r['kode_kbli_2025'] for r in canonical['data'] if r.get('_l2_source') == 'OSS_RBA_resiko_2025' and r.get('status_mapping') == 'MATCH_LANGSUNG' and (r.get('pp28_sources') or [None])[0] not in (None, r['kode_kbli_2025'])}) for tier2 — run against origin/main's canonical, never hand-typed.
